## Soul Nibbler (CR 2)

**XP** 600  
 N Tiny magical beast  

**Init** +2; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, scent; Perception +5  

  

**Defense**

 **AC** 15, touch 14, flat-footed 13 (+2 Dex, +1 natural, +2 size)  

**hp** 10 (1d10)  

**Fort** +2, **Ref** +4, **Will** +1  

**Immune** necromancy spells  

  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 15 ft., climb 15 ft.  

**Melee** bite +5 (1d3+2 plus energy drain)  

**Space** 2-1/2 ft.; **Reach** 0 ft.  

**Special Attacks** energy drain (1 level, DC 10)  

  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 2, **Dex** 15, **Con** 10, **Int** 2, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 2  

**Base Atk** +1; **CMB** +7; **CMD** 7 (11 vs trip)  

**Feats** Weapon Finesse  
*House rules: Weapon Finesse adds Dex instead of Str to finesse damage and CMB.*  

**Skills** Climb +10, Perception +5, Stealth +10  

  

**Special Abilities**

 **Immunity to Necromancy Spells (Ex)** Soul nibblers are immune to all spells of the Necromancy school.
